description:
TimeSplitters 2 is a time-travelling first person shooter.
Story levels, Arcade League missions and Challenges are unlocked by items; trophies and
story level completions are the checks.
tutorials: A guide to setting up TimeSplitters 2 for Archipelago.

v1.0.0.description:
First public release of the TimeSplitters 2 Archipelago world and Dolphin client (GameCube, North American version, game ID `GTSE4F`).

## Install
1. Download `timesplitters_2.apworld` below.
2. Double-click it (or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder) and restart the Archipelago Launcher.
3. Follow the [setup guide](https://github.com/captpurpleheart/ts2-archipelago/blob/main/timesplitters_2/docs/en_Setup.md). Dolphin's cheats must be off.

## Highlights
* Story levels, all 66 Arcade League missions and Challenges, characters, cheats, Silly Hats, arcade maps, game modes and weapons as items
* Trophies, story completions, 70 story objectives, Temporal Uplink cartridges and minigames, and milestones as checks
* 2401 Space Station or Trophy Hunt goals
* Progressive Starting Armour, Behead The Undead score multiplier, weapon buffs and optional cheat traps
* Easier Top Shot, Death Link and Universal Tracker support

Help and bug reports: https://discord.gg/M9cbCqc8sF

v1.2.0.description:
## New Features
- **Archipelago Shop** - A Shop has been added in-game! The "View Cutscenes" menu in Options has been turned into a Shop where you can spend points on Archipelago Items! Options has been renamed to "Options & Shop", and "View Cutscenes" has been renamed to "Archipelago Shop". The Shop holds 13 items, and items are priced based on their item type (Progression/Useful/Filler/Trap). Depending on how many Shop Locations (Max 65) you've chosen in your YAML, "Progressive Shop Restock" items are added to into the Item Pool. When you purchase an item, it gets sent to the player, and replaces that line with "Purchased". If you have a Shop Restock item, any "Purchased" line gets replaced with the next in-line item to buy. You can earn points by the following methods:
> 1. Getting Kills in any mode, counted as you make them, 1 Kill = 1 Point.
> 2. Earning Trophies in Arcade/Challenges, worth 10/20/30/40, counting the lower grades
> 3. Completing Story Levels based on difficulty 15/35/50, counting the easier difficulties
> 4. New Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum Trophy Filler Items.
- **Progressive Damage Resistances** - 5 Resistance types, Bullet, Explosive, Fire, Plasma and Melee. 6 of each, adding 10% Resistance of that type.
- **Death Link Changes** - Death Link now kills the player instead of force ending the Mission.
> *(Story Levels/Challenges still get "Failed" as the player is killed. Arcade League matches continue as Normal, you just die. :headstone: )*
- **Death Link Amnesty** - Death Link Amnesty has been added for Arcade League. You can choose how many times you must die in Arcade League in order to trigger a Death Link.
- **Award Screen** - The Award Screen after a Story Level/Arcade League/Challenge Mission now displays Archipelago items for both yourself and other players!
- **In-Game Text Announcements** - You will have in-game text announcements about items you send or receive, as well as large Trap activation announcement text.
> *(You can turn this is off in the Archipelago Client)*
- **Familiarity with TimeSplitters: Future Perfect** - Items for TimeSplitters: Future Perfect are recognised by TimeSplitters 2, and will have shortened names in the Awards Screen & Shop. So instead of "Challenge - Behead the Undead - Brain Drain", it will show as "Brain Drain" in the Awards Screen & Shop.
> *Must be TimeSplitters: Future Perfect (PurpleHeart's Version)*
- **Inventory Tab** - Weapon Buffs tab has been renamed to "Inventory Tab", which shows a Read-Only view of all items in the Shop and how many Points you have. It shows all your Resistances, Weapon Buffs, Score Multipliers and Progressive Starting Armour.
